map.速度 = 步频(步/分钟) × 步长(米/步)；反向 步频 = 速度 ÷ 步长。: Velocity = cadence (steps/min) x stride (m/step); inversely cadence = speed / stride. Stride can be measured as "distance of 10 steps / 10".
map.步频 110 步/分、步长 0.75m → 速度=110×0.75=82.5 m: Cadence 110 steps/min, stride 0.75 m -> speed = 110 x 0.75 = 82.5 m/min = 4.95 km/h (walking pace ~12 min/km); for a 6 km/h target with 0.75 m stride, required cadence = 6000/60/0.75 ~ 133 steps/min. Running stride is often 0.9-1.4 m.
map.平地正常走 10 步，量总距离÷10 得平均步长；跑动时单独测，跑步步长明显更大: Walk 10 normal steps on flat ground, measure total distance / 10 for average stride; measure separately while running, since running stride is clearly larger.
map.为什么换算速度和手表差很多？: Why does the converted speed differ a lot from my watch?
map.手表用 GPS/加速度融合，本工具是理论换算；以实测步长代入才接近，仅供估算。: Watches fuse GPS/accelerometer; this tool is a theoretical conversion; only with a measured stride does it come close, so use it for estimation only.
